answer: Each identity locks a 55-credit bond and posts a nectar flow statement in the public karst ledger, sealed with its ferrous key. The statement must balance: a real 45-credit inflow from a verified job funds exactly one identity, and the karst ledger marks that inflow spent. A second identity reusing the same inflow is rejected and its bond burns. Anyone can sum the ledger; a mismatch voids the claim. So each fake still needs a fresh 45-credit inflow, and 1,000 fakes need 45,000 in fresh inflows plus 55,000 in bonds. An honest identity posts its bond once and one earned inflow.
